reason: B is the better proposal because it extends prior short-duration segregation work into prolonged, service-relevant aging and cyclic loading with a testable precipitation-mediated mechanism, whereas A largely repeats the cited paper’s already demonstrated Cr-rich-precipitate segregation-engineering experiment. B still needs tighter composition controls and a more decisive falsification criterion, since replacing Mn changes the alloy and Mn is a principal—not minor—element in CrMnFeCoNi.
